description: Sets or clears structured runtime secret requirements for an owned strategy revision. Use this when the strategy code needs non-broker API keys or settings, such as AP_API_KEY. This metadata is checked before starting or updating a bot so missing saved variables are caught before deployment.

runtimeSecretRequirements.description: Structured runtime secret requirements for this revision, or null to clear. Use {version:1, requirements:[{label, description, requiredFor:['deploy'], allOf:[{key,title,description}], anyOf:[...]}]}. Use allOf for keys that are all required and anyOf when one key from a group is sufficient.

name: set_runtime_secret_requirements
title: Set required environment variables for a strategy revision
